import os, sys, base64, io
sys.stdout.reconfigure\(encoding='utf-8'\)
from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv\(\)
from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage
from extraction.schemas import ExtractionResponse
from extraction.prompts import PROMPT
from extraction.config import CONTENT_CROP
from extraction.imaging import normalize_image, crop_relative, img_to_png_bytes
from PIL import Image

API_KEY = os.getenv\('LLM_API_KEY'\)

img = Image.open\('mnt/data/screen 1.png'\).convert\('RGB'\)
img = normalize_image\(img\)
content_img = crop_relative\(img, CONTENT_CROP\)
b64 = base64.b64encode\(img_to_png_bytes\(content_img\)\).decode\(\)

for model in ['gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-1.5-flash', 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp']:
    try:
        llm = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI\(model=model, google_api_key=API_KEY\)
        s = llm.with_structured_output\(ExtractionResponse, include_raw=True, method='json_mode'\)
        r = s.invoke\([HumanMessage\(content=[
            {'type': 'text', 'text': PROMPT + '\\n\\nEstrai i campi richiesti dallo screenshot.'},
            {'type': 'image_url', 'image_url': {'url': f'data:image/png;base64,{b64}'}},
        ]\)]\)
        f = r['parsed'].fields
        ndg = \(f.ndg or {}\).get\('value'\) if hasattr\(f, 'ndg'\) else None
        print\(f'[OK] {model} -> NDG={ndg}'\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f'[FAIL] {model}: {str\(e\)[:100]}'\)
" 2>&1)
